title: 关于 MarketLink
intro: MarketLink 把胡志明市周边农夫市集的农户和来这里买菜的人连在一起。摊位发布本周会带来什么，你从中预订，再到摊位取货。
photosNote: 上面四张照片是占位图。

mission.title: 不再空手而归
mission.text: 摊位把一周的货写在小黑板上，所以早上最好的东西往往在大多数人到之前就卖完了。MarketLink 把每个摊位的一周放在同一个地方，并替你留着预订的东西，直到你来取。
mission.alt: 有顶棚的市集里的摊位，农产品堆放在木箱中

howItWorks.title: 周四预订，周六取货
howItWorks.text: 看看胡志明市周边四个市集本周末会有什么，想从几个摊位预订都可以。每个摊位各有自己的订单和取货时间，在摊位付款。
howItWorks.alt: 市集桌上摆着一篮篮胡萝卜、豆角和辣椒

technology.title: 下单那一刻，数量就是准确的
technology.text: 预订会立即从摊位的库存中扣除，所以不会有两个人同时订到最后两把。取货时段让排队更短，地图还会在市集里标出每个摊位的位置。
technology.alt: 种子和干土，旁边放着一把金属铲勺

benefit.title: 摊位知道该带什么来
benefit.text: 农户在采收前就能看到周末的订单，卖不掉带回去的就少了。你能在自己选的时间拿到计划好的柚子，钱直接付给种它的人。
benefit.alt: 一位农户用小型拖拉机在水田里耕作

why.title: 为什么要做 MarketLink
why.shoppers: 市集的早晨靠口口相传。摊位用粉笔写出带来了什么，老顾客打听下周有什么，其他人只能一排排走过去才知道。平时这样还行，可一旦你需要某样特定的东西，或者穿过大半个城市却只看到一张空桌子，就不行了。
why.farmers: 农户从另一边也面临同样的问题。他们很难告诉老顾客这周会有什么，没法在赶集日之前接单，也不知道周五傍晚该采多少。MarketLink 把两边都记录下来：摊位发布一周的货，你从中预订，摊位在采摘前查看订单。

limits.title: MarketLink 不做的事
limits.payment: 不提供在线支付。取货时在摊位把钱付给农户。整个产品里没有任何填写银行卡的地方。
limits.delivery: 不提供配送。所有订单都在市集取货，时间在摊位设定的时段内。
limits.certification: 不做认证。MarketLink 不核查执照或有机声明。请在摊位直接问农户。
limits.profiles: 没有单独的家庭成员资料。一个账户可以全家共用，系统不会区分同一账户里的不同人。

story.title: The Dilemma Behind Early Market Mornings
story.desc: Traditional morning markets run on word of mouth. That works until you travel across the city only to find an empty table.
story.farmerH3: Harvest too much and crops spoil; harvest too little and regulars leave
story.farmerDesc: Waking at 03:00 AM without knowing what will sell. Unsold produce wilts in tropical heat or gets squeezed below cost by wholesale middlemen.
story.customerH3: Searching for clean food for children, but arriving late means missing out
story.customerDesc: Authentic chemical-free produce vanishes before 07:00 AM. Arriving late leaves only wilted leftovers or untraceable commercial greens.
story.solutionH3: Reserve Thursday · Dawn Harvest Friday · Pick Up Saturday
story.solutionDesc: Farmers cut strictly what has been pre-ordered. Families secure prime dew-kissed produce with zero wasted labor or unsold crops.
story.quote: “When a grower knows their harvest has a guaranteed home, they can nurture the soil with complete peace of mind, free from chemical pesticides.”
story.quoteAuthor: Uncle Năm Tuấn · Củ Chi Eco-farm Owner (3-year partner)

journey.title: The 4-Step Farm-to-Table Journey
journey.desc: From rich morning dew in suburban plots to your family table in under 18 hours.
journey.step1Desc: Growers walk their plots in Củ Chi and Long An to inspect peak ripeness. They post exact available quantities on their MarketLink stall for shoppers to reserve in advance.
journey.step1Tip: No guesswork. You reserve what you need, and stalls know exactly how much to prepare.
journey.step2Timing: 🌅 Friday 05:00 AM · Dawn Harvest to Order
journey.step2Desc: At 05:00 AM, farmers harvest only the pre-reserved amounts. Greens are washed with clean water and packed gently into breathable wooden crates with zero crop waste.
journey.step2Tip: Nothing is harvested speculatively. Less than 2% produce loss compared to 35% in wholesale supply chains.
journey.step3Title: Fresh Baskets Arrive at Neighborhood Hubs
journey.step3Desc: Produce arrives directly at Thảo Điền, Phú Mỹ Hưng, and Bình Thạnh. Your pre-reserved basket is labeled with your name and kept cool in an allocated pickup stall.
journey.step3Tip: No long transit through industrial depots. Food travels from farm soil to your neighborhood in under 18 hours.
journey.step4Title: Inspect In Person & Pay Cash Directly
journey.step4Desc: Smell the soil, inspect crisp freshness with your own hands, chat with the grower about their crops, and pay cash directly into the farmer’s hands at the stall.
journey.step4Tip: Total peace of mind. You inspect quality before paying, and 100% of money stays with the hardworking grower.

values.title: Principles That Root Our Work
values.desc: Four non-negotiable promises that keep MarketLink faithful to the soil and community.
values.v1Desc: No exploitative middlemen. Every dong goes straight to the family farm growing your harvest.
values.v2Desc: Harvested at dawn, picked up before noon. Produce that never sees cold industrial storage.
values.v3Desc: Clear origin plots, honest harvest times, and direct handshakes with your family grower.
values.v4Desc: Farmers harvest only what has been pre-reserved on MarketLink, eliminating market discard.

regions.title: Four Preserved Growing Hubs
regions.desc: Carefully selected microclimates surrounding Saigon producing clean, seasonal nourishment.
regions.r1Desc: Rich river alluvium ideal for leafy bok choy, clean herbs, and natural hydroponic water spinach.
regions.r1Specialty: 🥬 Specialty: Crisp leafy greens & heirloom herbs
regions.r2Desc: Cool mountain temperate climate producing crisp sweet bell peppers, strawberries, and tender artichokes.
regions.r3Desc: Sun-drenched orchards growing natural sweet mangoes, pomelos, and heirloom seedless papayas.
regions.r4Desc: Fertile transition plains producing fragrant cantaloupes, sweet corn, and organic climbing gourds.
